summary.text: Racquel Armstrong is the Democratic candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 13 (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Democratic primary on July 21, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her as an assistant professor, and in a survey she described herself as an educator and Chandler resident.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Racquel Armstrong said she holds a BA from Wellesley College, an MSEd from the University of Pennsylvania, an MBA from The Ohio State University's Fisher College of Business, and a PhD from The Ohio State University.
She described herself as a cancer survivor and said her career has focused on education, leadership development and public service.

Armstrong listed her campaign messages as P-20 education funding and access, affordability including addressing utility price increases, and infrastructure upgrades to reduce reliance on the Colorado River.
She also named housing, health care access, workforce development, transportation, and climate and environmental protections as policy interests.
